instruction.text: How many metres make one kilometre? Choose the correct answer on the right side.

end.text: Good job. 1`km` is the same length as 1000`m`. This means that 1`km` is one thousand times longer than 1`m`.
end.sound: Good job. 1 km is the same length as 1000 metres. This means that 1 km is one thousand times longer than 1 metre.

hint.sound: 1 km is the same length as 1000 metres.

atoms.b: To convert a length given in kilometres to metres, the measurement needs to be multiplied by ((10 100 ++1000)).

instruction.text: The length of a road is 2 km. How long is the road in metres? Choose the correct answer.
The height of a mountain is 4 km. How high is the mountain in metres? Choose the correct answer.
The width of a lake is 3 km. How wide is the lake in metres? Choose the correct answer.
The length of a queue is 1 km. How long is the queue in metres? Choose the correct answer.
